title: Unit Event — Our Constellation of Song — Episode7 Constellation Of Song

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has done it at last. They've been signed by a record label! Reflecting on all of the people whose support has taken them this far, Ichika thinks of a way for the band to show their gratitude.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you! We hope you enjoyed our first song!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm so happy to be singing in front of such a large audience!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This place actually means quite a lot to us since it's where we decided to start pursuing music seriously...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: As a band, we were still just getting on our feet back then... We didn't know how to play well in front of a crowd.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But a lot has happened since then...
And we met people like all of you who were willing to give us their support.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Compared to before, I believe we've become much better at putting on performances that resonate with a lot of people.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And we couldn't have come this far without your support.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, as a small token of our appreciation... We're going to put on the best show we've ever done!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: (Who would've thought they'd get this good...?)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: (They're like a completely different band now compared to the last time they were here.)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: (I liked how they just put their feelings out in the open, but they were really desperate that time...)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: (In contrast, they're a single unit now and having a total blast.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(I feel a little tired...
But the audience seems to be enjoying everything.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'd like to say a few words before we move to our next song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, all this time I've been playing music, there's something I've felt again and again...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Music helps us communicate our feelings, and brings people together...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Music is what brought us together here today. It's allowed me to meet so many people.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
And our next song...
It's meant to be a beacon of hope for those who've drifted apart but wish to see each other again someday.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We hope it helps even a little bit...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's the feeling I'll have in my heart as I sing.

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: (I felt so much pain for so long. It didn't matter what I told myself. The thought of having to live away from Yota was horrible...)

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: (But every time I hear this song... It always gives me so much encouragement... It pushes me to move forward.)

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: (Including doing what I can to get along with my new family... And I'm here right now because of it.)

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line:
I'm really glad I'm here...
I couldn't be happier that I get to see this show with you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Ichika's pulling us forward...
I can feel more and more energy flowing into our performance.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(This feels awesome...
I bet we can play even better!)

rows.Speaker: Miu's Friend A
rows.Line: Hey, what were they called? Leo/need? They're amazing!

rows.Speaker: Miu's Friend B
rows.Line:
I know, right?! I just learned about them the other day, but they've written all these unbelievable songs.
Aren't you glad you came?

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: I plan on trying a little more at my next school.

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: Things might go well, but they might not. Whenever I feel sad or dejected, I'll just play my guitar...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: But I don't plan on giving up. I'm gonna keep trying...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line:
So please, Hinomori...
Do the same.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (The way Hoshino's singing... It's like I'm feeling what she is.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Her love of music, how much she enjoys singing and her kindness. She really wants to help others feel better...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Everyone here must see this song as a huge source of encouragement.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Hearing it has given them the power to stand up and move forward...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Because it tells them someone they care about is waiting for them up ahead... This song has the power to help people and bring them together.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This is what Hoshino's song is all about.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Next is song ten. Our last one...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you all very much for listening...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This has been beyond incredibly fun, but our next song will be our last.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I actually made this one using certain music software.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That software is called Hatsune Miku...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: To me, Miku isn't just a program for making music. I've learned so many important things from her...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She taught me the power of song when I was little...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: When I met Miku for the first time, I began learning so much about music.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku's the reason I was able to reconnect with the people I care about the most.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Saki, Shiho and Honami...
We're in a band now because of Miku. She brought us together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, because she's been watching over us the entire time and giving us so much support...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'd like to sing our last song with her.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Then, I hope you have a lot of fun.>
